caption: Dry sand pours from a cup onto a flat table, emptying the cup as a conical pile grows below.

clauses.text: The cup must be held at a slight angle to initiate the pouring motion.
The sand must flow continuously from the cup's opening onto the table surface.
The sand should accumulate on the table to form a conical pile as the cup empties.
The cup must be completely emptied before the pouring action concludes.
